- [2023/05/30] Friendster pivoted to a social gaming site in June 2011 and discontinued its social network accounts.
- [2023/05/30] Friendster shut down its site and services on June 14, 2015, and officially closed by the end of June 2018.
- [2023/05/30] Friendster experienced frequent CEO changes, with six different CEOs in seven years, starting with John Abrams in April 2004.
- [2023/05/30] Friendster's slow loading time and poor user experience contributed to its decline, despite eventually fixing the issue.
